purpose: Model and API reproducibility metadata for the ADR benchmark.
cached_token_treatment: No prompt cache was explicitly configured. Retained OpenAI response metadata records automatic cached input tokens. The estimate applies the full applicable input rate to all input tokens and does not apply a cached-input discount.
unsuccessful_call_usage_treatment: Unsuccessful requests without retained provider usage metadata are excluded.

models.retry_policy: Up to 3 total API attempts for transient provider/network errors, including 429/rate-limit, upstream reset, timeout, and overflow errors; waits 10 seconds, then 30 seconds on final API retry.
